placedLock.disposition: fully contained within the folder painted bounds at this lower-right location; union exposes no independent outer lock contour

artifactIdentity.limitation: The 16px and 24px files are separately rastered native proofs of one geometry. They are not independent optical-master constructions.

master16.finding: counter topology is threshold-unstable and disappears at the strict threshold; actual-size recognition rests on a few counter pixels

master24.finding: two counters survive low and middle thresholds but merge at the strict threshold

remainingIssues: The lock contributes no visible outer contour because its placed bounds are entirely inside the solid folder host.
The two Boolean rect holes approximate the source shackle and key-slot counters; they do not preserve the source counter curves.
At 16px the two-counter hierarchy is not robust across antialias thresholds, so the mark can read as apertures in a folder rather than a lock.

proposedReadOnlyExperiment.master16: Use a distinct program with a slightly larger lock part and lower/right placement so its body projects beyond the folder edge, then use correspondingly enlarged semantic shackle and key-slot holes.
proposedReadOnlyExperiment.master24: Keep a smaller lock than the 16px program but move it far enough right/down to expose a measurable outer shoulder before applying the two holes.
